propositions: The project must establish a single documentation ownership policy covering eight documentation categories: tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence.
Documentation policy must restore writing rules and protected forms as author-facing guidance without introducing deterministic character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose validators or gates.

Generated artifact inventory must be cataloged in docs/generated-artifacts.md with GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED collections as enforcement sources, with all consumers pointing to the new location.
Documentation policy must require ticket corrections through append-only events and preserve ADR decision substance through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement rather than erasure.

Policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md must reference the documentation ownership, correction, and writing guidance policy without describing guidance as a deterministic gate.
